problem: A production deploy can be ready/current and exact-main while one or more functional capability readbacks are still open or failing. Treating deploy readiness as whole-system green would create a false-green.
root_cause: Deployment truth and capability truth are different evidence classes. Netlify ready/current proves hosting promotion; it does not independently prove pricing interactions, NL↔EN route roundtrip, connector readiness, social publication outcome, or other functional contracts.

evidence.observed_rule: Exact production identity was proven independently from functional readback state.
evidence.truth_boundary: This learning records the separation of deployment proof and functional proof; it does not assert every capability is green.

prevention: Represent deployment_state and functional_state separately in all Powerhouse status projections.
LIVE means exact provider-side production promotion exists; FUNCTIONAL_GREEN means the relevant capability readback also passed.
Never infer pricing, NL↔EN, connector, content, social, or business outcome success from Netlify ready/current alone.
Every material live promotion writes Brain learning, skills, agent/chat contract, ledger/docs and System Map in the same obligation lineage.
Future chats/agents inherit this automatically and must not require the user to repeat 'borg / leg vast / documenteer'.
